launches.title: LemonLime – Automate your workflows with a single click
launches.tagline: AI that learns your business and self-creates automations, without writing a single line of code.
launches.body:
Hey everyone! We're [Jordan](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jordan-zietz/) and [Daniela](https://www.linkedin.com/in/danielamunoz12/), founders of LemonLime.

**TL;DR**

Most companies don't have the time or technical expertise to build custom AI automations. LemonLime connects to your existing tools, studies your business, and builds specialized automations for you — actual outcomes, fast.

<https://youtu.be/aFcB1fJhPmY>

**The problem**

Every small business knows they should be "using AI," but almost none of them can. We learned this firsthand doing custom AI consulting for businesses. After building workflows for a handful of customers, two things immediately became obvious:

1. The context AI needs to succeed is scattered — files, documents, chat threads, you name it. Searching for and organizing this information was 95% of the work, every single time.
2. Companies don't want to spend weeks learning another complicated new tool. That's a huge ask for busy teams.

Small businesses need impact out-of-the-box, they don’t have the time or capital to spend on fancy AI initiatives that aren’t creating value from day one.

**Our solution**

Since company information is all over the place, we started by building the layer underneath that powers AI search and retrieval. If you’ve heard the term “company brain”, that’s what this first layer is. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=104861&key=user_uploads/3669391/f4cccbb6-1c98-4e2d-a37e-0d4603f8e3e5)

Then, we took it a step further.  Value from day one.  

After your company’s unique knowledge architecture is built, users can use plain-language to deploy agents and automations that support their business without writing a single line of code.  You tell it what you want automated, LemonLime automates it.  It’s that easy.

Don’t know where to start?  No worries, LemonLime handles that, too. After running deep research on your business, LemonLime automatically surfaces suggested automations that you can implement with a single click.  

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=104861&key=user_uploads/3669391/cdca4a15-4d2b-4807-9014-51ad700dbeb0)


**If you’re a small business, let’s talk <3**

Don't have time to handle automating your sales, marketing, support, or something else? **We’ll set it up for you.** Email us at [hello@lemonlime.ai](mailto:hello@lemonlime.ai).

\
Or, visit our website to get started: [lemonlime.ai](http://lemonlime.ai)
